Change an Inbox rule; a condition you give replaces its old values

Related commands:
  rules view
  rules list
  folders list

Output:
  Shows text you can read in your terminal.
  Use --json to get JSON for scripts and other programs.
  Use --jq to filter the JSON output with a jq expression.
  Use --template to format the output with a Go template.

Usage:
  maildo rules update <rule-id> [flags]

Examples:
maildo rules update rule-id --account work --subject-contains invoice --subject-contains receipt
maildo rules update rule-id --move-to Archive --apply
maildo rules update rule-id --no-mark-read --apply --json

Flags:
      --account stringArray              Account to use (default: the active account)
      --apply                            Change the rule; without --apply maildo only shows what would change
      --from stringArray                 Match mail from this address (repeatable; comma lists accepted)
      --has-attachments                  Match messages with attachments
      --header-contains stringArray      Match a message header that contains this text (repeatable; any value matches)
  -h, --help                             help for update
      --mark-read                        Mark matching messages as read
      --move-to string                   Folder to move matching messages to
      --name string                      Name of the rule
      --no-has-attachments               Remove the has-attachments condition
      --no-mark-read                     Remove the mark-read action
      --no-stop-processing               Remove the stop-processing action
      --recipient-contains stringArray   Match a recipient address that contains this text (repeatable; any value matches)
      --sender-contains stringArray      Match a sender address that contains this text (repeatable; any value matches)
      --sequence int                     Place in the order rules run, from 1 to 2147483647; no other rule may use it
      --stop-processing                  Run no later rules on a message this rule matched
      --subject-contains stringArray     Match a subject that contains this text (repeatable; any value matches, but different conditions must all match)

Global Flags:
      --config string     Path to the config file
      --dry-run           Preview changes without performing them
      --include-meta      Wrap the JSON output as {data, meta} with request details
      --jq string         Filter the JSON output with a jq expression
      --json              Output stable JSON instead of the human view
      --no-ansi           Disable all ANSI/control sequences in human output
      --no-color          Disable color in human output
      --no-pager          Never use a pager for long human output
      --no-prompt         Never block on an interactive prompt
      --quiet             Suppress non-essential output
      --template string   Format the JSON output with a Go text/template
